source.title: Felici Artisan Gelato — what ADVO shipped, read from advo-ph/felici-gelato2
source.summary: A scroll-driven marketing site for the gelato brand of Reign Capunfuerza, built as a static React SPA: landing video, canvas word sequences, a 16-flavour selector, and two store locations.

meta.provenance: case-study.ts, each feature cites a file in the client repo

fact.claim: Felici Artisan Gelato is a Food & beverage · Rizal build: A scroll-driven marketing site for the gelato brand of Reign Capunfuerza, built as a static React SPA: landing video, canvas word sequences, a 16-flavour selector, and two store locations.
fact.quote: A scroll-driven marketing site for the gelato brand of Reign Capunfuerza, built as a static React SPA: landing video, canvas word sequences, a 16-flavour selector, and two store locations.

fact.claim: Felici Artisan Gelato: Orientation-aware landing video — A full-viewport muted loop that swaps between landscape and portrait sources on orientation change, overlaid with film grain and a wordmark that fades out once the visitor scrolls past 80 pixels.
fact.quote: A full-viewport muted loop that swaps between landscape and portrait sources on orientation change, overlaid with film grain and a wordmark that fades out once the visitor scrolls past 80 pixels.

fact.claim: Felici Artisan Gelato: Canvas word sequences — The hero plays a 177-frame sequence at 40fps and the story band a 151-frame one, decoded through createImageBitmap onto a 2D canvas rather than shipped as video, so the type stays crisp at any density.
fact.quote: The hero plays a 177-frame sequence at 40fps and the story band a 151-frame one, decoded through createImageBitmap onto a 2D canvas rather than shipped as video, so the type stays crisp at any density.

fact.claim: Felici Artisan Gelato: 16-flavour selector — A pinned section where cone buttons and a thumbnail grid swap the centre cup, the giant italic name and the stage colour. Flavours carry real status badges — Bestseller, New, Must Try, and Not Available for Asin Tibuok.
fact.quote: A pinned section where cone buttons and a thumbnail grid swap the centre cup, the giant italic name and the stage colour. Flavours carry real status badges — Bestseller, New, Must Try, and Not Available for Asin Tibuok.

fact.claim: Felici Artisan Gelato: Two-store locator — Postcards for the Cainta cafe and the Angono gelato counter, each with its own opening hours, a muted loop that plays only once scrolled into view, and an outbound Google Maps link.
fact.quote: Postcards for the Cainta cafe and the Angono gelato counter, each with its own opening hours, a muted loop that plays only once scrolled into view, and an outbound Google Maps link.

fact.claim: Felici Artisan Gelato: Contact form with a mail fallback — Validated name, email, subject and message. It POSTs JSON when a contact endpoint is configured and otherwise opens a prefilled mailto, so the form still works with no backend deployed.
fact.quote: Validated name, email, subject and message. It POSTs JSON when a contact endpoint is configured and otherwise opens a prefilled mailto, so the form still works with no backend deployed.

fact.claim: Felici Artisan Gelato: Mobile memory and iOS viewport work — Not a visible feature, but the reason the site survives a phone: a frozen viewport unit so the iOS URL bar cannot resize full-screen sections, capped device pixel ratio, a 32-frame ring buffer, and ImageBitmaps closed after playback so the tab is not killed.
fact.quote: Not a visible feature, but the reason the site survives a phone: a frozen viewport unit so the iOS URL bar cannot resize full-screen sections, capped device pixel ratio, a 32-frame ring buffer, and ImageBitmaps closed after playback so the tab is not killed.

fact.claim: Felici Artisan Gelato runs on Vite 5 · React 18 SPA · react-router-dom 7.
Felici Artisan Gelato runs on GSAP 3 + ScrollTrigger · Lenis smooth scroll.
Felici Artisan Gelato runs on Canvas 2D image-sequence player via createImageBitmap.
Felici Artisan Gelato runs on Self-hosted webfonts · static client-only build.
Felici Artisan Gelato integrates: Google Maps as outbound search links, not an embed.
fact.quote: Google Maps as outbound search links, not an embed

fact.claim: Felici Artisan Gelato integrates: Instagram and Facebook brand profiles.
Felici Artisan Gelato integrates: mailto delivery by default, optional POST endpoint.
fact.quote: mailto delivery by default, optional POST endpoint
